index 0000000..5c1ef9d
--- /dev/null
+++ b/test/integration/targets/ansible-galaxy-collection/tasks/upgrade.yml
@@ -0,0 +1,142 @@
+---
+- name: install the older collection and its dependencies
+  command: ansible-galaxy collection install 'upgrade.parent:1.0.0' -s galaxy_ng -p '{{ upgrade_path }}'
+
+- name: leave installed collections alone without --upgrade
+  command: ansible-galaxy collection install upgrade.parent -s galaxy_ng -p '{{ upgrade_path }}'
+  register: upgrade_without_flag
+
+- name: check the non-upgrade install was skipped
+  assert:
+    that:
+    - "'Nothing to do. All requested collections are already installed' in upgrade_without_flag.stdout"
+
+- name: keep the newest installed version within a restrictive constraint
+  command: ansible-galaxy collection install -U 'upgrade.parent:<2.0.0' -s galaxy_ng -p '{{ upgrade_path }}'
+  register: upgrade_constrained
+
+- name: check the constrained upgrade was skipped
+  assert:
+    that:
+    - "\"Installing '\" not in upgrade_constrained.stdout"
+
+- name: upgrade the parent without changing dependencies
+  command: ansible-galaxy collection install -U --no-deps upgrade.parent -s galaxy_ng -p '{{ upgrade_path }}'
+  register: upgrade_no_deps
+
+- name: read the versions after --no-deps
+  slurp:
+    path: '{{ upgrade_path }}/ansible_collections/upgrade/{{ item }}/MANIFEST.json'
+  loop:
+  - parent
+  - child
+  - leaf
+  register: upgrade_no_deps_versions
+
+- name: check --no-deps only changed the requested collection
+  assert:
+    that:
+    - "\"Installing 'upgrade.parent:2.0.0'\" in upgrade_no_deps.stdout"
+    - (upgrade_no_deps_versions.results[0].content | b64decode | from_json).collection_info.version == '2.0.0'
+    - (upgrade_no_deps_versions.results[1].content | b64decode | from_json).collection_info.version == '1.0.0'
+    - (upgrade_no_deps_versions.results[2].content | b64decode | from_json).collection_info.version == '1.0.0'
+
+- name: upgrade dependencies to satisfy the installed parent
+  command: ansible-galaxy collection install --upgrade upgrade.parent -s galaxy_ng -p '{{ upgrade_path }}'
+  register: upgrade_with_deps
+
+- name: read the versions after upgrading dependencies
+  slurp:
+    path: '{{ upgrade_path }}/ansible_collections/upgrade/{{ item }}/MANIFEST.json'
+  loop:
+  - parent
+  - child
+  - leaf
+  register: upgrade_with_deps_versions
+
+- name: check transitive dependencies and upper bounds
+  assert:
+    that:
+    - "\"Installing 'upgrade.parent:\" not in upgrade_with_deps.stdout"
+    - "\"Installing 'upgrade.child:2.0.0'\" in upgrade_with_deps.stdout"
+    - "\"Installing 'upgrade.leaf:2.0.0'\" in upgrade_with_deps.stdout"
+    - (upgrade_with_deps_versions.results[0].content | b64decode | from_json).collection_info.version == '2.0.0'
+    - (upgrade_with_deps_versions.results[1].content | b64decode | from_json).collection_info.version == '2.0.0'
+    - (upgrade_with_deps_versions.results[2].content | b64decode | from_json).collection_info.version == '2.0.0'
+
+- name: repeat the upgrade
+  command: ansible-galaxy collection install -U upgrade.parent -s galaxy_ng -p '{{ upgrade_path }}'
+  register: upgrade_repeated
+
+- name: check an up-to-date graph is unchanged
+  assert:
+    that:
+    - "\"Installing '\" not in upgrade_repeated.stdout"
+
+- name: fail when no permitted version exists with --no-deps
+  command: ansible-galaxy collection install -U --no-deps 'upgrade.parent:>2.0.0' -s galaxy_ng -p '{{ upgrade_path }}'
+  register: upgrade_impossible
+  failed_when: false
+
+- name: check the constraint failure is clear
+  assert:
+    that:
+    - upgrade_impossible.rc != 0
+    - "'upgrade.parent:>2.0.0 (direct request)' in upgrade_impossible.stderr"
+
+- name: install an older version for prerelease checks
+  command: ansible-galaxy collection install 'namespace1.name1:1.0.0' -s galaxy_ng -p '{{ upgrade_path }}'
+
+- name: upgrade without prereleases
+  command: ansible-galaxy collection install -U namespace1.name1 -s galaxy_ng -p '{{ upgrade_path }}'
+  register: upgrade_stable
+
+- name: include prereleases when requested
+  command: ansible-galaxy collection install -U --pre namespace1.name1 -s galaxy_ng -p '{{ upgrade_path }}'
+  register: upgrade_prerelease
+
+- name: keep prereleases within the declared constraint
+  command: ansible-galaxy collection install -U --pre 'namespace1.name1:<1.1.0-beta.1' -s galaxy_ng -p '{{ upgrade_path }}'
+  register: upgrade_prerelease_constrained
+
+- name: check stable and prerelease versions
+  assert:
+    that:
+    - "\"Installing 'namespace1.name1:1.0.9'\" in upgrade_stable.stdout"
+    - "\"Installing 'namespace1.name1:1.1.0-beta.1'\" in upgrade_prerelease.stdout"
+    - "\"Installing 'namespace1.name1:1.0.9'\" in upgrade_prerelease_constrained.stdout"
+
+- name: install older versions for a requirements file upgrade
+  command: ansible-galaxy collection install '{{ item }}' -s galaxy_ng -p '{{ upgrade_path }}/requirements'
+  loop:
+  - upgrade.parent:1.0.0
+  - namespace1.name1:1.0.0
+
+- name: write upgrade requirements
+  copy:
+    dest: '{{ upgrade_path }}/requirements.yml'
+    content: |
+      collections:
+      - name: upgrade.parent
+        version: '<3.0.0'
+      - name: namespace1.name1
+        version: '<1.1.0'
+
+- name: upgrade every collection in the requirements file
+  command: ansible-galaxy collection install -U -r '{{ upgrade_path }}/requirements.yml' -s galaxy_ng -p '{{ upgrade_path }}/requirements'
+  register: upgrade_requirements
+
+- name: check both requirements were upgraded
+  assert:
+    that:
+    - "\"Installing 'upgrade.parent:2.0.0'\" in upgrade_requirements.stdout"
+    - "\"Installing 'namespace1.name1:1.0.9'\" in upgrade_requirements.stdout"
+
+- name: repeat the requirements file upgrade
+  command: ansible-galaxy collection install -U -r '{{ upgrade_path }}/requirements.yml' -s galaxy_ng -p '{{ upgrade_path }}/requirements'
+  register: upgrade_requirements_repeated
+
+- name: check the requirements file upgrade is idempotent
+  assert:
+    that:
+    - "\"Installing '\" not in upgrade_requirements_repeated.stdout"
